items.title: Nepal in talks with China to reopen Tatopani border point: Minister Lamsal
items.summary: Kathmandu, October 6 Minister for Infrastructure Development Sunil Lamsal said the government is in continuous dialogue with China to reopen the Tatopani border point. Lamsal made the statement at a meeting of the Parliamentary Special Committee on the Impact of Climate Change in the Himalayas, Climate Justice and the Bhotekoshi-Trishuli Disaster held at Singha Durbar.
